name: travel-social-platform
description: 个性化旅行记录、沉浸式内容发现、活跃旅行社区平台

scripts.dev:windows: start cmd /k "cd server && npm run dev" && timeout /t 2 /nobreak >nul && start cmd /k "cd client && npm start"
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd ../mobile && npm install
